'''Dame''' '''Melanie Joanne Welham''' {{Post-nominals|country=GBR|DBE}} (born 1964) is a British biochemist who was Executive Chair of the [[Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council]] from April 2018 to June 2023. She was previously a professor of biochemistry at the [[University of Bath]], where she worked on stem cell biology.

== Early life and education ==
Welham was born and raised in [[Suffolk]]. Her father worked in agriculture, and she was the first member of her family to attend university. She studied biochemistry at [[Imperial College London]], where only 15% of undergraduate students were women.<ref name=":0">{{Citation |title=Give Me Inspiration! The Paradigm Shift with Professor Melanie Welham |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gBuI7IS7BSU |access-date=22 June 2023 |language=en}}</ref> She moved to [[University College London]] for doctoral research, where she studied the [[oncogene]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Functional and genetic analyses of the V-"src" oncogene {{!}} WorldCat.org |url=https://www.worldcat.org/title/941042125 |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=worldcat.org |language=en}}</ref> She then moved to the [[University of British Columbia]], where she worked as a postdoctoral researcher between 1989 and 1995.<ref name=":0" />

== Research and career ==
Welham joined the [[University of Bath]] as a lecturer in 1995, where she worked on molecular signalling and stem cell science. She was the first woman to be promoted to Professor at Bath.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Melanie Welham |url=https://www.physoc.org/honorary_member/melanie-welham/ |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=The Physiological Society |language=en-GB}}</ref>

Welham joined [[Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council]] (BBSRC) on secondment in 2012.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Professor Dame Melanie Welham |url=https://www.ukri.org/about-us/how-we-are-governed/executive-committee/melanie-welham/ |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=www.ukri.org |language=en-US}}</ref> In 2018, Welham was made Executive Chair of [[Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council|BBSRC]], two years prior to this, she served as Interim Chief Executive of the Council.<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Melanie Welham selected for the role of Executive Chair of the Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council |url=https://www.gov.uk/government/news/professor-melanie-welham-selected-for-the-role-of-executive-chair-of-the-biotechnology-and-biological-sciences-research-council |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=GOV.UK |language=en}}</ref> 

She served as Executive Champion for People, Culture and Talent at [[UK Research and Innovation]].<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=Finding for the Modern Copernicus Today - Talk and Panel Discussion - Poland in the UK - Gov.pl website |url=https://www.gov.pl/web/unitedkingdom/finding-for-the-modern-copernicus-today---talk-and-panel-discussion |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=Poland in the UK |language=en-GB}}</ref> She was made a trustee of the [[Royal Society of Biology]] and the University of Bristol in 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Executive Chair of BBSRC, UKRI, appointed as RSB Trustee |url=https://www.rsb.org.uk/news/www.rsb.org.uk//news/executive-chair-of-bbsrc-ukri-appointed-as-rsb-trustee |access-date=22 June 2023 |website=RSB}}</ref>

She was appointed a [[Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire|DBE]] for services to the biosciences in the [[2023 Birthday Honours]].

Welham was awarded an [[Honorary Doctorate]] of Science by the University of Bath in January 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Dame Melanie Welham: oration |url=https://www.bath.ac.uk/corporate-information/professor-dame-melanie-welham-oration/ |access-date=2025-09-22 |website=www.bath.ac.uk}}</ref> The award recognises 'her dedication to promoting the values of scientific excellence, interdisciplinary research, career development and equality, diversity and inclusivity in academia.'<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Dame Melanie Welham: oration |url=https://www.bath.ac.uk/corporate-information/professor-dame-melanie-welham-oration/ |access-date=2025-09-22 |website=www.bath.ac.uk}}</ref>
